 ORANGE BEACH | GULF SHORES | PERDIDO KEY

 
 

 
 

 

 
 
 

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 BUT WAIT, THERE'S MORE!

 
 

 
 Once you’re finished Parasailing with us, don’t miss out on all of our other AMAZING services!

 

 

 
 

 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 DOLPHIN CRUISES
 

 
 
 (opens in new window)
 
 
 

 
 We guarantee you will see dolphin while taking a relaxing cruise aboard The Southern Rose. A great time for all ages, we offer the best dolphin cruises in the area.

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 BOAT RENTALS
 

 
 
 (opens in new window)
 
 
 

 
 Rent a pontoon or tritoon boat at our OB Watersports location! We’ve got the best pontoon boat rental rates around, and you’ll have a great time.

 

 

 
 

 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 JET SKI DOLPHIN TOURS
 

 
 
 (opens in new window)
 
 
 

 
 Jet across the crystal waters at your own pace on our 20 mile tour of Orange Beach’s beautiful coastal waterways. Our experienced guides will show you the highlights of several different islands while we observe majestic Bottlenose Dolphins.

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 WAVERUNNER RENTALS
 

 
 
 (opens in new window)
 
 
 

 
 We offer locations to ride on the beautiful Gulf of Mexico and in the calm waters of the back bays. Whether you are looking for a fun and exhilarating ride or to see million dollar homes and majestic dolphins, we have the outing for you!

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 BANANA BOAT RIDES
 

 
 
 (opens in new window)
 
 
 

 
 Take a Banana Boat ride right from the beach! Enjoy Banana Boat rides at our Gulf Shores, Fort Morgan and Perdido Key locations.

 

 

 
 
 

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
Pause

 
Play Video

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Are you ready to fly?

 
 

 
 
 Chute 'Em Up Parasail has been offering amazing parasailing adventures in the Orange Beach area since 2004! Experience incredible views of the Alabama Gulf Coast while soaring up to 800ft above the beautiful Gulf of Mexico. As the premier Orange Beach parasail provider, we take pride in providing extremely fun and safe parasailing trips to customers ages 3 and up. We offer the largest fleet of parasail boats in the world, with 15 U.S. Coast Guard approved vessels that can each carry up to 15 passengers for parasailing in Gulf Shores, AL. Picture Packages are a great way to document your parasail flight, and include 40-60 high quality images!

 Our guides, Chase and Chen were awesome. Very funny, great pictures, and obviously experienced. They made the price + tip very much worth it! It was my brother and I’s first time parasailing, and I don’t think we could’ve had a better time. I couldn’t stop laughing when we got dipped in the water!

 Tanner and Aubrey were fantastic, and very supportive with this being my first parasailing adventure. My husband and I took our 13 yr old and we all had a blast! The two guys were very professional and made the trip very enjoyable! We will definitely be back next year during our vacation!!
